questions.question: What happens if I leave something behind?
answer_facts: The caretaker checks the villa after every check-out and logs anything left behind.
Unclaimed items after 30 days are donated, except passports and ID documents, which are handed to the local police station.

questions.question: After my last stay, I realized I may have left my phone charger in the villa. What can I do?
answer_facts: Tell us as soon as possible what you left and where.
The caretaker checks the villa after every check-out and logs anything left behind.

questions.question: How much do you charge to ship items internationally?
answer_facts: International shipping is at cost plus ₹1,000 handling; we can't ship liquids, food, medicines or valuables over ₹20,000 internationally.
We can courier items within India at cost plus a ₹300 handling fee, paid in advance by UPI or card.
